title: What Circumference Actually Measures
description: A simple visual explanation of pi and the circumference formula, using a circle with radius 5.
narration_lines: Here's a circle with a radius of 5.
The distance around it is always 2 times pi times the radius.
2 times 3.14 times 5 is 31.4. That's the circumference.

params.footnote: pi (≈3.14) is just how many 'radiuses' wrap around, doubled
